nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $f \in \mathbb{Z}_p[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}_p^n$, and suppose that for some index $i$ the $p$-adic absolute values satisfy $|f(a)|_p < |(\partial f / \partial x_i)(a)|_p^2$, that is, $\operatorname{ord}_p f(a) > 2 \operatorname{ord}_p (\partial f / \partial x_i)(a)$. Then there is a point $x \in \mathbb{Z}_p^n$ with $f(x) = 0$.
nodes.title: Multivariable Hensel lemma over the p-adic integers

nodes.summary: Let $p \ne q$ be primes with $p \equiv q \equiv 1 \pmod 8$ and Legendre symbol $\left(\frac{p}{q}\right) = 1$, and let $E$ be the elliptic curve $y^2 = x^3 - 2pqx$ over $\mathbb{Q}$. If the rank of the group $E(\mathbb{Q})$ of rational points is odd, then it equals $1$, $3$ or $5$.
nodes.title: Odd-rank curves y² = x³ − 2pqx: rank one, three or five case

nodes.summary: Let $p \ne q$ be primes and let $E$ be the elliptic curve $y^2 = x^3 - 2pqx$ over $\mathbb{Q}$. Suppose that $(p \bmod 8, q \bmod 8)$ is one of $(3, 3)$, $(3, 5)$, $(3, 7)$, $(5, 5)$, $(5, 7)$, or that $p \equiv 1 \pmod 8$, $q \equiv 3, 5$ or $7 \pmod 8$ and the Legendre symbol $\left(\frac{p}{q}\right)$ equals $-1$. If the rank of the group $E(\mathbb{Q})$ of rational points is odd, then it equals $1$.
